title: Height limitations for narrow buildings or enlargements
previewText: In C1 or C2 Districts mapped within, or with a residential equivalent of, R7-2, R8, R9 or R10 Districts, the provisions of Section 23-738 (Height limitations for narrow buildings) shall apply to portions of buildings with street walls less than 45 feet in width.
